license_message: The RONE beta has ended. Sign in with your roneaudio.com account to unlock the plugins - new accounts get a 7-day free trial at roneaudio.com.

plugins.name: RONE Reverse Reverb
plugins.description: Tempo-synced reverse reverb for risers, vocal swells and seamless transitions - tail lengths from 1/32 to 8 bars, shaped with fades, filters and stereo width
plugins.whats_new: The playback controls are real host parameters now. Reverse Reverb had none at all - nothing of it appeared in a DAW automation list - and OUTPUT GAIN, the four fade controls and the whole tremolo section (on/off, depth, pan, rate, shape, mode and all three divisions) can now be automated, wrapped in proper automation gestures so Touch and Latch record them, and right-clicked for the host menu. The interface follows an automation clip live. The controls that feed the offline re-render of the tail - reverb size, dry/wet, tail, BPM, width, low cut, transition - stay interface-only on purpose: re-rendering a tail mid-playback is not something automation can do sanely. Fades are also saved with the session now, which they never were.

plugins.name: RONE Stutter
plugins.description: Tempo-locked stutter engine - beat divisions, sculpted fade curves and stereo movement for instant fills, edits and glitch builds
plugins.whats_new: Dragging audio in from Cubase now works. A project-window event is rendered on the spot and handed over as a promise rather than a plain file, and the plugin now picks that up, so you can drop an event straight off the timeline instead of exporting it first.

plugins.name: RONE Stucker
plugins.description: One knob that grabs the loop and rolls it up - the captured slice shrinks tighter and tighter until it screams, then lets go right back into the beat
plugins.whats_new: A new MIX control in the bottom right corner sets the dry/wet of the stuck signal. It sits at 100 % by default, where the plugin behaves exactly as before, and it is fully automatable: ride it down to pull a long roll back under the mix and bring it up again without a click, mid-stutter.

plugins.name: RONE Throw
plugins.description: One knob that throws anything into a tempo-locked atmosphere - a dotted-8th ping-pong delay whose band-limited feedback loop stays clean at near-infinite feedback, so the wash sits behind the mix instead of muddying it
plugins.whats_new: First release. One knob throws whatever is playing into a tempo-locked atmosphere: the send, the feedback and the reverb open together, and the dry signal is never touched - it only ever adds a layer. DUAL gives the left and right sides their own divisions for 3:2 cross-rhythms, SPACE is the reverb on the wet, and DUCK keeps the atmosphere out of the way while the source is still playing. 26 factory presets in the bar at the top, plus six macro slots: tap to recall, hold to store your own.

plugins.name: RONE Flanger
plugins.description: A transition riser flanger - sweep it by hand or engage INFINITE barberpole mode for endless bar-locked rises and falls, with feedback, stereo offset and a rhythmic gate
plugins.whats_new: Host automation now moves the knobs. The interface follows the plugin's own parameters live, so an automation clip, a host preset recall or a second open window all show up on screen instead of leaving the controls frozen where you last left them. Every move you make is also wrapped in an automation gesture now, so hosts in Touch or Latch record it properly.

plugins.name: RONE AFTERSPACE
plugins.description: Creative reverb, delay and atmosphere designer - huge cinematic spaces that stay clean via built-in ducking, a tail de-esser (SILK), auto-gain and tempo-synced echo, all in one plugin
plugins.whats_new: Remote lock now bites within a minute: signing out of the Center, a revoked or expired pass locks the plugin even while it is open, and the window shows a sign-in screen with OPEN RONE PLUGINS CENTER. Also: the plugin is named RONE AFTERSPACE in your DAW and ships with a PDF manual.

plugins.name: RONE Analyzer
plugins.description: Professional measurement suite: 30-band spectrum with reference-track comparison, vectorscope, level meters, EBU R128 loudness and bit statistics
plugins.whats_new: A full user manual now ships in the install folder and opens from the Center's card menu.
